notes.title: v1.4.1 now live
notes.notes:
A small update to the game just went up. 

[list]
[*] Bugfix:  "End of Time" achievement should now unlock properly
[*] Update: The music option has been split into two separate options: Terrestrial Music, and Interstellar Music. If you prefer to only have music in space, or only down on earth, you now have the option.
[/list]

You may need to open and save your options in order for the new interstellar music option to switch on. If you find you don't have any music in space, please check your options first. 

If you notice any other bugs or problems, or have any other feedback, please let me know.

Thanks!

notes.title: v1.4 now live - Linux, bug fixes, and weight loss
notes.notes:
A new build is now live!

- Linux version! Currenlty supporting Ubuntu 16.04 64 bit only. I'm not sure about how it would run on other distributions. I think older versions of ubuntu would likely work ok. 

- There was a bug where the dolphin's speed was getting 'throttled' when hitting the water after an enviornmental speed boost (Ring, Polar Express, etc.). As soon as the dolphin hit the water, the extra speed would be taken away. This should be working properly now. You may find your speed picking up a bit more quickly. 

- While working on the linux version, I noticed that the build size was a little out of whack. After examining the data files for the game, I discovered several large audio files which were not being used anymore in the final build. Long story short, the install size of the game was almost halved after removing them and a few other files. Sorry for wasting your hard drive space! The game should now take up 55-65mb or so (each OS is slightly different).

- There are also a few minor UI tweaks

If you have any problems with the latest update, please post a discussion topic, or email support@rawkins.com. Thanks!

notes.title: Mac version now available!
notes.notes:
The Mac version of Dolphin Up is now available. If you've already bought the game, it should be ready to install in your Steam library. The game requires OS X version 10.6 or later. Please see the system requirements on the store page for more details. 

If you have any issues with the mac build, please email support@rawkins.com, or post a discussion topic. Thanks!
